branding.tagline: Live, validated QuickBooks reports that refresh each time you open them.

description: Live QuickBooks Online reports for your Reports library, including profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance, general ledger, aged receivables and payables, GST and BAS, sales and supplier reports, budgets, dashboards and management report packs. Each report reads your connected QuickBooks company every time it opens, checks its own figures and shows the result. You can download it as PDF or Excel, or share it. Find the reports in Reports, under From your plugins. Read-only in QuickBooks.
name: quickbooks-reporting-studio
